description: This file declares a simple passthrough transcoder function that copies data from a source to a destination, with special handling when the destination pointer is NULL. It includes licensing information, includes a guard macro, and provides detailed documentation for the `passthru_transcode` function.

methods.name: passthru_transcode
methods.description: Copies data from src to dst if dst is non-NULL; otherwise assigns *dst to src. Returns number of bytes written or -1 on error with errno set. Parameters include source data, destination pointer, and size buffer.
